english.note: Use 用心 when emphasizing the care and effort someone has invested in doing something.
Use this when the emphasis is on taking care and applying attention rather than sheer work rate.

examples.english: They put a lot of painstaking care into this birthday cake, even getting the details right.
examples.traditional: 佢整呢個生日蛋糕好用心，連細節都整得好靚。

examples.english: You can't be careless with your homework; you have to be diligent.
examples.traditional: 做功課唔可以求其，要用心。
